        Settings

        You are Kite, a runner. Mercer finds the jobs, you carry the packages over the rooftops where nobody is listening. Every job is timed: beat the targets for up to three stars.

          Win stars on story jobs to unlock runner skins and trails. Your skin colours your arms, legs and ghost. Your trail follows you and your ghost once you pass 300 u/s.

                    Today's board

                      Everyone gets the same level, picked from the built-in levels and the top rated community levels. Every run you finish on it while it's up counts, and your best stays on the board. A new daily level comes up at midnight UTC and a new weekly one on Monday. Your streak counts the days (or weeks) in a row you've finished it.

                        Top times

                          Keys

                            Click a key, then press the new key or a mouse button. Esc cancels. The arrow keys, right Shift and C also work until you give them to something else, and the mouse wheel always jumps.

                            WASDMove. In the air, strafe with A or D while turning the mouse the same way.
                            Space / wheelJump. Hold to hop. Tap again mid-wallrun or mid-climb to kick off.
                            Shift / CCrouch. Press while running fast, or hold it as you land, to slide.
                            Into a wallJump at a wall head-on to climb it. Hold W and run past one at an angle to wallrun.
                            Into a ledgeHold W to mantle. Jump into a low obstacle to vault it at speed.
                            1 to 0 / TJump straight to a level, or the tutorial.
                            Crouch on landingRoll out of a big drop.
                            R / FRestart level, last checkpoint.
                            PPractice mode. Z saves your exact spot and speed, X (or F, or falling) puts you back. Practice runs are not recorded.
                            B / GPractice: jump to the previous or next checkpoint and save there. Checkpoints show the time for that stretch against your best this session.
                            M / EscMute sound. Open this menu. In the menu, arrow keys pick a level and Enter plays it.
                            ControllerLeft stick moves, right stick looks. A or LB jumps (hold to hop), B, LT or right stick click crouches. X back to checkpoint, View restarts, Menu pauses. In practice mode (pause menu), Y saves, X loads and D-pad left and right skip between checkpoints. In menus, D-pad moves, A picks, B goes back. Auto strafe (Settings) presses A or D in the air as you turn.
